text:
alex: deploybot blocked push of redwood/backend:release-2026-03-21 -> provenance check failed between us-ecr and gcr mirror. Anyone seeing this?

deploybot: deploybot: push rejected: provenance-mismatch (manifestDigest != attestation.targetDigest) region: gcr-eu -> required by policy. See logs: https://ci.internal/logs/1762129999

marta: oh — was a manual retag in the CI job for the canary. I pushed a fast retag earlier to unstick staging. Maybe I forgot to re-run attestation.

sam: If we retag we need to regenerate cosign attestation, right? Can't just copy tag.

ryan: Correct — attestation ties to digest. If we reuse tag but different digest, deploybot will reject.

alex: We need a decision: (a) republish with correct attestation and small change window 11:30-12:00 UTC, or (b) pin consumers to prev digest and roll forward later. Opinions?

infra-ops: :eyes: current traffic for backend during window is low. Pinning is fastest.

marta: I can re-run build and cosign sign. Estimated 12m. But need KMS access — can someone grant temporary key usage?

sam: I can grant KMS for the build principal. Doing it now. Also adding a proforma release note: 'Fix: re-publish backend image with provenance to satisfy deploy guard'

deploybot: deploybot: KMS grant detected -> signing allowed. However, GCR mirror may still show old manifest for ~5m; we'll delay promote until checks pass.

ryan: Plan: Marta republishes at 11:40 UTC, I'll monitor mirror sync + run `gcloud container images describe` and `cosign verify`. If mirror lag >5m, pin consumers to digest abcdef12345 and schedule rollout at 14:00 UTC.

marta: running build: `bazel run //images/backend:publish -- --tag=release-2026-03-21`

alex: also documenting in release notes and internal cherrypicks. Sam pls add to release-tracker.

sam: Added note and created a hotfix PR referencing this thread. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pull/402

deploybot: deploybot: publish completed, cosign ok. Verified digest: sha256:deadbeefcafebabe... mirror check start

ryan: gcr has new manifest, cosign verify output: `Verified OK` on eu mirror. :tada:

infra-ops: :thumbsup: I'm running a quick smoke canary against canary cluster. 5 requests successful.

alex: closing loop: no rollback needed. Release note: 'image republished to correct provenance, small outage risk mitigated by pinning policy' I'll update ops-runbook.

marta: thanks. I'll follow up to add an automated step in CI to re-sign retagged images.

sam: closing thread. file for audit: audit-id=img-1762129999
